body:
All eight files now contain doc comments only, no code or attribute changes. Contract links checked: `Periodo` (in scope), `DataMtr` via `super::newtypes::DataMtr`, `FormatoDownload` (in scope), `ModificacaoTipo::Recebimento` (same module), `CpfCnpj` (in scope). No clippy/tests run, per assignment.

**Files edited:** `cdf.rs`, `criacao.rs`, `recebimento.rs`, `modificacao.rs`, `cancelamento.rs`, `aceitar_alteracao.rs`, `download.rs`, `parte.rs` — module roots, all structs, fields and enum variants documented with system/operation context and wire formats.

**Uncertainty noted:** the assignment brief mentioned romaneio-unit `quantidade: f64` and `TimestampMs` fields; none of the assigned files contain those types (quantities appear only as `f64` in `ResiduoCriacao`/`ResiduoRecebido`, documented by their owning module; `TimestampMs` appears only in prose about adapter wire conversion). The `DataMtr` format was corrected per parent guidance: `dd-MM-yyyy` output, with ISO 8601/epoch-ms accepted only on `Periodo` input, while plain `NaiveDate`/`NaiveDateTime` fields use derived serde ISO serialization.
